ITA.scope: Italian general government (State, social security institutions and local authorities, consolidated), 1990; 1,198.1 lire per US$. Rates approximate; tax split within groups estimated. Spending by function from ISTAT, scaled to the Bank of Italy total of 706,100 bn lire.

exps.name: Public debt interest
exps.note: Interest on public debt, 1990 (Table 14). The game works out debt interest itself, so this line is skipped on import.

exps.name: General public services
exps.note: Legislature, executive, tax and finance administration, foreign affairs and general services, excluding debt interest.

exps.name: Defence
exps.note: Armed forces, Carabinieri military functions and defence procurement.

exps.name: Public order and safety
exps.note: Police, fire services, courts and prisons.

exps.name: Economic affairs
exps.note: Subsidies and investment in industry, agriculture, transport, energy and employment schemes.

exps.name: Environmental protection
exps.note: Waste, water treatment and environmental protection.

exps.name: Housing and community amenities
exps.note: Housing, urban development, water supply and street lighting.

exps.name: Health
exps.note: National health service (USL) running costs and benefits in kind.

exps.name: Recreation, culture and religion
exps.note: Sport, museums, broadcasting and cultural bodies.

exps.name: Social protection
exps.note: Pensions (INPS and others), unemployment and wage supplement, family and welfare benefits.
